questions.prompt: 100bb, single-raised pot, you have top pair top kicker on A72 rainbow, heads-up, in position. Best default?

choices.text: Bet for value. You are not all-in yet and the board is dry.
Check-fold the turn no matter what
Jam 100bb on the flop as the only size

questions.explanation: This is the standard-depth value bet from the postflop path, not a short-stack shove.

questions.prompt: 70bb, you called a 3-bet with 76s and the flop is ace-high and dry. Best default?

choices.text: Fold to a bet. The stack is too short to float a miss.
Call any size because suited connectors always continue

questions.explanation: At 70bb the implied odds you wanted are already gone if you missed.

questions.prompt: 100bb, you have a set on a wet flop. Best default?

choices.text: Bet or raise. There is enough behind to get value and to charge draws.
Treat the stack as 20bb and jam only aces

questions.explanation: A set at 100bb wants a bigger pot. You are not forced all-in before the bet.

questions.prompt: You cover the table with 100bb and a player has 15bb. A decision against that player uses…
questions.explanation: You cannot win more than they have in front of them.
